Target On A Robots-Denied Host

This body must never be served, because robots.txt disallows the host.

Synthetic S6-1 target fixture. Not a copy of any real page.
contract_intent: Its host's robots.txt disallows everything, so RobotsDenied is decided BEFORE any request. This fixture exists precisely so a test can assert it was never opened — proving the denial preceded the fetch rather than followed it.
